summary: VisionWave Holdings filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity program of up to $30,000,000 of common stock under an At The Market Issuance Sales Agreement dated September 18, 2026 with Aegis Capital Corp. as sales agent, pursuant to an effective Form S-3 shelf (File No. 333-297939). Aegis receives a 2.0% commission on gross sales and acts on a commercially reasonable efforts basis; there is no escrow. Shares, par value $0.01, trade on Nasdaq Global Market under VWAV, last reported at $0.38 on September 17, 2026. Watch dilution and pricing pressure.
